::: {.content-visible when-format="typst"}
## Profile
:::

I'm a Senior Research Scientist specialising in **reinforcement learning, world models, and distributed post-training for embodied robotics**. 

My work spans **world models**, **Lyapunov stability functions**, and **sim-to-real transfer for humanoid robotics**, with algorithms implemented from scratch in JAX and PyTorch. I've published at **ICRA**, **NeurIPS**, and **IROS**, and serve as a reviewer for top ML and robotics venues.

Previously, I've held research roles at Cambridge Consultants (humanoid RL & VLAs) and Agile Loop (agentic AI pipelines), where I led teams and delivered production research to clients including Google Cloud and Lenovo.

---

### Research Interests

- Reinforcement learning for robotic control
- VLA/WAM post-training
- Neural Lyapunov functions for stability
- Continual, multi-task and meta-learning
- World models and model-based RL
